title: Ro Ro ke Sakina ne Kaha
body:
Ro ro ke sakina ne kahan aye phupi amma
Kab aayenge dariya se chacha aye phuphi amma
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kyu shimre layeen ne mere maare hai tamache
Kyu jakda gala rassi me gohar mere chine
Kya aisi Hui mujhse khata
aye phuphi amma
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kyu Tukde hua barchi se Akbar ka kaleja
Kyu ghode se rondha gaya nausha ha ka laasha
Kya chid gaya asgar ka gala
aye phuphi amma
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hai bara gale ek rasan haye qayamat
Main baithu to hoti hai buzurgo ko aziyat
Uthti hu to ghutta hai gala
aye phuphi amma
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kyu aapki chini hai musalmano ne chadar
Kyu jakda hai rassi me bimar baradar
Kya humse koi jurm hua
aye phuphi amma
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Begoro kafan Kyu hai mere baba ka laasha
Is dasht me Kya koi kafan bhi nahi deta
Hai inka koi Aur khuda
Aye phuphi amma
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kya mujhko na mil paayega ab baap ka seena
Ab Raat ko soyegi kahan jaake sakina
Mar jaungi main ab ba khuda
Aye phuphi amma
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Mil jaaye agar qaide sitamgar se rehai
Sugra se yeh keh dena aye ghum ki satai
Behna ne bohat Yaad Kiya
Aye phuphi amma
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kyu pusht pe bimar ke maare gaye durre
Kyu rohnde gaye ghodo ki tapo se yeh laashe
Khamosh hai Kyu karbobala
Aye phuphi amma
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Aalamo masayab se chura Kyu nahi dete
Farzand ko aap iske shifa Kyu nahi dete
Hai kabse pareshan Raza
Aye phuphi amma
